SUMMARY: Review of HEAD (2100c9b115f4) identifies 1 confirmed bug in core collection utilities.
POINTS:
- [core/src/main/java/com/taobao/arthas/core/util/collection/ThreadUnsafeFixGaStack.java:25] checkForPush() guard `current == max` is dead code; `push()` increments `current` past capacity, triggering an uncontrolled ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException and corrupting stack state instead of cleanly rejecting the push — fix: change guard to `current == max - 1` to correctly block overflow before the increment.

suspicions.observation: In ThreadUnsafeFixGaStack.checkForPush(), the guard condition is `if (current == max)` but the array has size `max` (valid indices 0..max-1). After `++current` in push(), current becomes `max` which is out of bounds. The correct check should be `current == max - 1`.
suspicions.suspected_bug: checkForPush() never throws its ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - the real AIOOBE comes from elementArray[++current] when current==max-1, making the guard check dead code. One extra element can be pushed past capacity, causing an uncontrolled array index exception instead of the intended guard.

bugs.evidence: ThreadUnsafeFixGaStack.java:25 - checkForPush() guard `current == max` is dead code; ++current in push() corrupts current to max before JVM array bounds check fires, so subsequent peek()/pop() fail with AIOOBE instead of the guard cleanly rejecting the push without state corruption.
